analysis.title: ITT Inc. (ITT): First Take: 3Q inline, orders strong, 4Q guided ahead
key_insights: ITT reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $2.26 vs GS consensus of $2.14 and FactSet consensus of $2.08.
3Q26 segment EBIT was 0% vs GS and +1% vs FactSet consensus, helped by Motion Technologies (MT) at +1% and Connect and Control Technologies (CCT) at +7% vs FactSet on EBIT.
Organic growth was +6.0% vs GS +6.9%. Motion Technologies (MT) and Flow Technologies (FT) each came in about 1% below GS expectations. CCT organic growth of +18.6% (GS: +12.0%) offset the shortfall.
Organic orders grew +20.5% y/y, up from +13.3% in 2Q26 and -3.8% in 3Q25, so the comparison base is easy. CCT organic orders were +55.3%.
ITT raised its FY26 EPS guide to $8.54-$8.62 from $8.12-$8.32, against GS and consensus of $8.30 and $8.27. The guide now assumes organic growth of +7-9% (prior +5-8%).
The FY26 guide implies 4Q EPS of $2.23-$2.31 vs consensus of $2.12.
FY26 free cash flow is now expected at $600mn-$620mn, up from $550mn-$580mn.
GS calls the quarter inline with a guide well ahead of consensus. It expects shares to outperform on the raise and wants more color on order conversion timing on the call.
GS rates ITT Buy with a 12-month price target of $271, based on 17.0x its Q5-Q8E EBITDA. The stock closed at $201.03 on 4 Nov 2026, implying 34.8% upside.

market_movers.rationale: Inline 3Q with strong orders and a FY26 EPS guide well above consensus. GS expects shares to outperform on the raise.

earnings_insights: ITT 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $2.26 vs GS estimate $2.14 and FactSet consensus $2.08 (reported 4 Nov 2026).
3Q26 total revenue reported $1,419mn vs GS estimate $1,441mn and FactSet consensus $1,417mn. Revenue growth was +42% y/y.
3Q26 total segment operating income reported $317mn, matching the GS estimate of $317mn and above the FactSet consensus of $313mn. Segment margin was about 22%.
3Q26 organic growth reported: total +6.0% vs GS estimate +6.9%. MT +1.8% vs GS +3%, FT +6.0% vs GS +7%, CCT +18.6% vs GS +12%.
3Q26 organic orders reported +20.5% y/y (MT +6%, FT +11%, CCT +55%).
FY26 EPS guidance raised to $8.54-$8.62 from $8.12-$8.32 (GS estimate $8.30, consensus $8.27). Implied 4Q26 EPS is $2.23-$2.31 vs consensus of $2.12.
FY26 organic growth guide is +7-9% (prior +5-8%). FY26 FCF guide is $600mn-$620mn (prior $550mn-$580mn).
